# Gulf News

> > Gulf News is the leading English-language news source covering UAE, Middle East, and international news with comprehensive coverage of politics, business, lifestyle, and regional developments.

Published by Al Nisr Publishing in Dubai, Gulf News provides breaking news and in-depth analysis on UAE affairs, regional conflicts, business markets, entertainment, and practical living guides for residents and visitors. The publication has been a cornerstone of Dubai's media landscape with extensive coverage of major events including Expo 2020 Dubai and regional developments.
